network.confirmMainnet: You are switching to Mainnet. Real assets will be used. Continue?

home.noSchedule: No vesting schedule was found for {{address}}.

1.title: Schedule not found
1.explanation: No active vesting schedule exists for this wallet address.
1.action: Ask your sponsor to create a stream for your address.

2.title: Cliff not reached yet
2.explanation: Your tokens are still locked. The cliff period has not passed.
2.action: Check the cliff date and come back then.

3.title: Invalid duration
3.explanation: The total vesting duration must be longer than the cliff duration.
3.action: Increase the total duration or decrease the cliff duration.

4.title: Invalid rate
4.explanation: The token rate per ledger must be a positive number greater than zero.
4.action: Enter a rate of at least 1.

5.title: Deposit overflow
5.explanation: The computed total deposit is too large to process.
5.action: Reduce the rate or duration so the total deposit stays within limits.

6.title: Schedule already exists
6.explanation: A vesting stream is already active for this recipient.
6.action: Cancel the existing stream before creating a new one.

7.title: Nothing to claim
7.explanation: There are no tokens available to claim at this moment.
7.action: Wait for more tokens to accrue and try again.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.action: Please try again or contact support.

wizard.walletDescription: You need a Freighter wallet to sign and pay for the stream deposit.
wizard.tokenDescription: Choose the SAC token to stream. The sponsor wallet must hold enough to cover the full deposit.
wizard.customTokenHelp: Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) address starting with C. Must be an issued Soroban token on this network.
wizard.recipientHelp: Stellar account (G…) that will receive streamed tokens.
wizard.rateHelp: How many tokens drip to the recipient per ledger (~5 s). Must be a positive integer.
wizard.cliffHelp: Number of ledgers before any tokens unlock. At the cliff, all accrued tokens release instantly. Must be less than total duration.
wizard.totalHelp: Total length of the vesting stream in ledgers. Remaining tokens drip linearly after the cliff until this end point.
wizard.invalidRate: Rate must be a positive integer.
wizard.invalidCliff: Cliff duration must be less than total duration.
wizard.reviewBeforeSigning: Review all values before signing. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
wizard.depositWarning: The full deposit of {{deposit}} {{token}} will be transferred from your wallet on confirmation.
wizard.streamCreatedDescription: Tokens are now locked. The recipient can claim after the cliff.
wizard.signDescription: Clicking Sign & Submit will open Freighter for your approval.
